_comment: Source of truth for every game count stated in public copy.
Do not hand-edit the numbers in HTML or llms.txt -- run scripts/build-game-counts.mjs.
'arcade' and 'daily' are NOT listed here: they are derived automatically from
play/*/ and play/daily/index.html, because both live in this repo and can be
counted exactly. Only the Android game counts need declaring, because their
source (each app's constants/games.ts) lives in the companion monorepo, which
is not guaranteed to be checked out in CI.
When a volume gains a game: update the number here, run the script, commit.
Locally the script cross-checks these against the monorepo and fails on a
mismatch, so a stale entry cannot survive a run on a dev machine.
